queue.title: R1 — Nifty weekly iron condor, carried overnight (defined-risk premium selling)
queue.detail: Nifty option VRP is earned mainly overnight (Bhat-Pandey-Rao 2024); short +/-600 strangle carried overnight showed t=2.55 over 453 trades (Algo Bench), but tail days were gap days -> cap risk with wings to fit ₹1L.

queue.title: R2 — Replace naked ATM buy with a debit vertical (same signal as current bot)
queue.detail: Current bot's pre-friction expectancy is ~ -₹85 to -₹110/trade and friction ~₹300/trade (bot logs). A vertical cuts premium outlay ~70% (less slippage in ₹ and less theta/vega) at the cost of 2x brokerage. Direct A/B test vs current baseline.

queue.title: R3 — Supertrend(10,2) on 30m Nifty, expressed as a monthly debit spread (₹1L proxy)
queue.detail: Algo Bench: Supertrend(10,2) 30m Nifty via ATM monthly synthetic futures, Oct-2022->Jul-2026: 543 trades, t=2.21 (t=1.92 on futures with 5-pt cost) but needs ~₹3.5L and DD -2,324 pts. Fragile to multiplier (1.8/2.2/2.5 much weaker).

queue.title: R4 — India VIX regime switch (meta-rule choosing R1 / R2 / flat)
queue.detail: Sell defined-risk premium when implied vol is rich, buy spreads only when vol is cheap and price is trending; stand aside otherwise. Garg & Vipul 2015: VRP exists in Nifty options but is largely eaten by costs except for low-cost writers -> trade it only when premium is fat.

queue.title: R5 — Event & expiry overlay (filter applied to every directional rule)
queue.detail: In the bot's own ₹1L REAL test, 'event veto' cut losses from -21.1% to -10.9% (and drawdown -42.6% -> -33.8%) — the most consistent single filter. Expiry days carry extra ELM, settlement-mechanics changes, and retail concentration (42% of expiry-day volume, Agarwal et al. 2025).

queue.title: R6 — Time-exit option buying (ON PROBATION — failed walk-forward)
queue.detail: Cutting non-performing longs after 60 min (keep only if premium >= +10%) shrank avg loss from ~₹3.1k to ~₹1.8k; full-period REAL +₹43.0k (138 trades) at ₹1L. BUT walk-forward selected it in-sample (+₹50.9k) and it lost OOS (-₹7.9k, 49 trades; Oct-2026 alone -₹16.0k).

queue.title: R7 — FII index-futures positioning bias (EXPLORATORY, no published edge found)
queue.detail: Free daily NSE participant-wise OI gives FII long/short index futures. Hypothesis only: trade R2 direction only when it agrees with FII net index-futures change. No source found demonstrating an edge — treat as a pure hypothesis and count it as a trial.

queue.title: R8 — Far tail wings on frozen F4 pre-expiry strangle (TESTED 26-Oct-2026: REJECTED)
queue.detail: frozen F4: sell CE/PE at ±1.0 EM, 1 trading day before expiry, VIX 252d pct >= 0.30; buy CE/PE at ±w EM (w in 2.0/2.5/3.0)

queue.title: R9 — Nifty monthly 14-DTE defined-risk strangle/condor (TESTED 26-Oct-2026: FAILED, see changelog)
queue.detail: MarketCue: 14-DTE monthly strangle passed both Y1 and Y2 (Oct-2024..Sep-2026): +₹79,181, 23 trades, 78% win, PF 2.49, DD −₹22,583. Fewer, longer trades -> edge per trade far above Indian costs (our 24-Oct priority).
